excerpt.zh: 星系中心的居民目前遭受一股未知势力的攻击，他们请求我们的帮助。如果他们失败，我们或许就再也无法知晓自己的命运。
excerpt.en: Under assault from an unknown force, the entities currently inhabiting the center of the galaxy have requested our assistance. Should they fall, we know not our fate.

texts.zh: 星系中心的居民目前遭受一股未知势力的攻击，他们请求我们的帮助。如果他们失败，我们或许就再也无法知晓自己的命运。
texts.en: Under assault from an unknown force, the entities currently inhabiting the center of the galaxy have requested our assistance. Should they fall, we know not our fate.

sections.zh: 我们不进行干涉，任由冲突演变。
sections.en: We will let this conflict proceed without interference.

sections.zh: 如果我们将自己回收的星界丝缕交给这些存在，他们可以用它来加强自己的护盾。
sections.en: If we were to deliver our recovered astral thread to these beings, they could use it to fortify their shielding.

sections.zh: 异星天然气在这个存在的古怪泡泡中有放大效果。我们可以利用它来增强我们的武器。
sections.en: Exotic gases have amplified effects in this strange bubble of existence. We can use it to enhance our weaponry.

sections.zh: 我们必须消灭最后的入侵者，才能让无形异使正确地封印[Root.Target.GetName]恒星系。
sections.en: We must eliminate the last of the invaders for the Formless to properly seal the [Root.Target.GetName] system
